    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = case["required_symbols"]
    nodes_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children_map = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:

            children_map[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    # sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_ids = sorted(nodes_map.keys(), key=lambda x: (-nodes_map[x]["depth"], x))
    retained = set(nodes_map.keys())
    removal_order = []
    for nid in sorted_ids:
        node = nodes_map[nid]
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        if any(child in retained for child in children_map.get(nid, [])):
            continue
        # try removal
        retained.remove(nid)
        # check required symbols
        ok = True
        for sym in required_symbols:
            if not any(nodes_map[rid]["symbol"] == sym for rid in retained):
                ok = False
                break
        if ok:
            removal_order.append(nid)
        else:
            retained.add(nid)  # revert
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {"retained": retained_sorted, "removal_order": removal_order}
